text:
noah: Postmortem is published for the span telemetry gap + aggregator mismatch. Short: a batching boundary change dropped tail spans and a schema rename caused daily rollup divergence. Using this thread to record owners and dates.

ops-bot: Postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/1923456789

evie: I'll own the ETL batching hardening. Plan: revert the non-deterministic jitter, add fixed-window tests, and cap max batch size. PR target: Wed EOD.

priya: I'll handle aggregation reconciliation and schema-compat checks. Work: add tolerant join logic, reconciliation checksums, and a dashboard tile. ETA: next Mon.

carlos: I'll runbook the incident playbook and draft customer-facing notes. Also coordinate backfill windows with SRE.

noah: Backfill scope estimate: ~3.5h of data across 2 tenants (~420k spans). Recommend canary tenant then full. Typical backfill command: `./tools/reprocess --start 2026-05-01T01:00Z --end 2026-05-01T04:30Z --tenant <id> --rate 1500/s --dry-run`. Expect ~1.2h per tenant with rate cap.

evie: Local tests pass. Patch details: restore left-inclusive window, deterministic jitter seed, add payload-size guard. PR: https://github.com/redwood/etl/pull/458 cc @priya for recon concerns.

priya: Added metric `spans.dropped_pct` and `agg.recon_failures`. Alert rules: spans.dropped_pct > 0.2% for 10m -> page; agg.recon_failures > 0 -> page. Dashboard: https://dashboards.internal/d/obs/1923456789

carlos: Runbook updated with steps: pre-checksum, dry-run backfill, validate checksums, roll-forward. Draft comms uploaded: https://docs.internal/incident-comms/1923456789

ops-bot: Reminder set: Tue 09:00  canary check-in meeting.

evie: Canary to 5% now. Monitoring spans/sec and CPU.

priya: Canary looks good: spans.dropped_pct down from ~1.4% -> 0.03%. Reconciliation sample matched.

carlos: Tracker updated: ETL hardening -> evie (PR 458); Aggregation checks -> priya (ticket OBS-1022); Runbook & comms -> carlos. Target close date: 2026-05-10.

noah: Noting pattern: batching/window changes causing regressions ~3rd time this year. Filing OBS-1023 for automated monthly smoke tests that exercise tail windows and schema-evolution cases.

evie: After canary verification I'll merge PR and post a blameless summary to the postmortem doc.

carlos: Once backfill canary is verified we'll schedule the full backfill and close incident; open infra follow-ups remain tracked in the remediation board.

ops-bot: Incident follow-up checklist updated.
